scenario.title: Test 10: EMI Reduction / Balance Transfer Request
dialogue: I am actually looking to reduce my existing EMI through a balance transfer.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Sunil Mehta, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Sunil Mehta?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I am actually looking to reduce my existing EMI through a balance transfer.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you for sharing that, Sunil Mehta. Since you already have an existing loan on this property and are looking for EMI reduction or loan transfer, this is handled directly by our dedicated Loan Transfer & EMI Specialist. I am arranging a direct transfer callback for you. Thank you for your time with Home Credit!
